articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 10, 2026-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS) today announced that the company will release its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 ended August 1, 2026, after the market close on Wednesday, September 2, 2026.
articles.title: Tilly’s, Inc. to Report Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Operating Results on September 2, 2026
